node.title: Re^3: By the shine on my bald pate, I dislike this encoding stuff
node.author: poj
node.doctext:
Empty string

All the content is read into @LINES so $filedata is empty

my(@LINES) = ;
my $filedata = ;

Maybe try

my @LINES = ;
my $filedata = join '',@LINES;

or just

open ORDERFILE, '<', $emailfile or die "$emailfile: $!";
my $filedata = do { local $/;  };
close ORDERFILE;
poj
